summary: Iteration 6 backend-only regression + full verification of guard rails (order status transitions + refund scope) and Nest Notes (photo reviews). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6_guardrails_photoreviews.py with 29 tests across 7 classes hitting the live external ingress via EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Result: 29/29 PASSED in 10.58s. All iteration-6 acceptance criteria verified: (a) STATUS_TRANSITIONS map — paid→created rejected (400 'invalid transition'), created→paid→shipped→delivered succeeds each step, delivered is terminal (any next state incl. cancelled rejected 400), same-status is no-op success with history entry appended, cancel from created|paid|shipped all 200, cancel from delivered 400; (b) refund_scope — cancel from created OR paid refunds points_redeemed (order_refund tx with meta.order_id, balance restored to pre-order value), cancel from shipped does NOT refund, repeated cancel (same-status no-op) is idempotent (exactly one refund tx); (c) photo reviews — POST /products/{id}/reviews stores photos[] and GET returns them, 5-photo payload truncated to 3 (MAX_REVIEW_PHOTOS enforced), first review WITH photos returns points_earned=100 and adds 'photo_review_bonus' tx +100 to user_points balance, second review by same user with photos returns points_earned=0 (no re-award), review WITHOUT photos returns points_earned=0, later adding photos to a previously photo-less review DOES award 100 (first-time photo bonus tracked via prev.photos inspection); (d) seed skip — /api/products returns 41+ items stably across reads (settings.seeded marker prevents destructive reseed on restart); (e) admin_edited flag — POST /products by admin sets admin_edited=True on doc AND visible via GET /products, PUT /products also sets admin_edited=True; (f) no _id leak sweep — reviews-with-photos, order status responses, points transactions all recursively scanned _id-free.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1259 lines — still well beyond the 700-line split threshold. Recommend splitting into routers/ modules (auth, products, taxonomy, editorials, shortlists, orders, payments, reviews, points, interactions, recommendations).
Deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') still used (server.py:1205, 1256) — migrate to FastAPI lifespan context manager.

Startup still runs destructive db.editorials.delete_many({}) on every restart (server.py:1250). Any admin-edited editorial sections are wiped on `supervisorctl restart backend`. Products are now protected by admin_edited/seeded checks, but editorials are not.

OrderStatusIn.status is not constrained — accepts any string; ALLOWED_STATUSES validation is manual. Use Literal['created','paid','shipped','delivered','cancelled'] for automatic 422 + accurate OpenAPI schema.

ReviewIn.photos has no per-item size cap. A user could POST 3 x 5MB base64 photos and bloat the MongoDB doc past the 16MB BSON limit. Recommend capping each photo's length (e.g. max_length=2_000_000 chars per data URL) or store photos in GridFS/object storage and persist only URLs.
ReviewIn.rating still lacks pydantic ge/le constraints — validated manually at server.py:645. Use conint(ge=1,le=5) so 422 is returned automatically.
Review body/title still have no length cap — a user could store multi-MB text.

Points bonus is upsert-based on (product_id,user_id) but the had_photos_before check reads prev.photos on a doc that may already have been updated by a race (two concurrent POSTs by same user). In practice single-user race is unlikely but add a MongoDB transaction or atomic $setOnInsert guard for strict idempotency.
seed_data_creation: Tests self-create ~10-12 disposable users per run (TEST_it6*_<hex10>@garlicnest.com) with unique numeric-derived mobiles, plus disposable orders/reviews/interactions. One TEST_it6 product is created via admin POST and cleaned up via DELETE within the same test. Backend seed data untouched. No admin delete-user endpoint exists, so TEST_it6* users accumulate across runs — main agent may consider adding an admin cleanup endpoint.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-6 acceptance items verified. Key behaviours confirmed live: (1) STATUS_TRANSITIONS map at server.py:195 enforced in PUT /api/admin/orders/{id}/status — same-status is silently permitted (no-op success with history append), any other invalid transition returns 400 with body 'Invalid transition: <cur> → <new>'. (2) Refund guard at server.py:1148 uses refundable_prev = current in {'created','paid'} — only these two source states trigger _award_points(reason='order_refund', meta.order_id=<id>) on cancel; cancel from 'shipped' completes (200) but no refund tx is created. (3) Photo bonus at server.py:672 — compares prev-doc's photos truthy vs incoming photos truthy: awards 100 pts exactly once on first transition from 'no photos' to 'has photos' per (product,user). Second submission with photos returns points_earned=0. (4) MAX_REVIEW_PHOTOS=3 truncation happens server-side at line 647 (list slicing) — client can send N and receive top-3. (5) admin_edited=True is force-set on both POST and PUT /products (server.py:575, 585); protects against destructive reseed on next restart (server.py:1226-1228 checks admin_edited OR settings.seeded). Test file is self-contained, idempotent, safe to re-run. Uses xdist -n 0 to run serially (module-scoped fixtures interact).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no backend bugs found. All 29 assertions pass on first run against the live external ingress. One initial test-side bug (email lowercase mismatch) fixed within the test file; not a server issue.
